decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the panel-button, slide-switch, reset, touch-input, and BOOT-button mapping; no addition or edit is required.
The GPIO and control mapping does not change the existing connector-destination inventory, which already covers touch inputs, buttons, and reset.
The source maps panel controls and touch inputs and does not alter addressable-LED power, switching, or level-shifting behavior.
The source does not change the standalone USB-power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered scope.
The panel GPIO mapping has no effect on the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source does not change the INA219 selection or the monitored 3.3V rail.
None of the mapped panel-control GPIOs changes the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The source does not alter the power sources, OR-ing method, diode requirement, or source-selection behavior.
The source assigns unrelated panel and touch GPIOs and does not change the charge-status LED assignment on GPIO13 or its power-board interface.
The source does not revise either interboard connector pinout, the matching-numbering rule, or the unresolved power-connector pin order.
The complete panel-control mapping does not mention or replace the previously established GPIO5 assignment for 5V_EN.
The main-board panel GPIO mapping does not affect the battery connector's type, placement, pin functions, mounting style, or unresolved pinout.
